passages.title: Recording 1
passages.text: Woman: Are you coming to the shopping centre later? I need to buy a new pair of trainers for the gym. Man: I'd love to, but I have to finish my history project first. Maybe I can join you around five o'clock?

passages.title: Recording 2
passages.text: Girl: Did you see the new market in the town square? They sell amazing handmade jewellery. Boy: Yes, I went yesterday! I bought a gift for my sister's birthday. It was quite expensive, but worth it.

passages.title: Recording 3
passages.text: Man: I'm planning to go hiking this weekend if the weather is nice. Would you like to come? Woman: That sounds great, but I've already promised to help my brother move house on Saturday morning.

passages.title: Recording 4
passages.text: Woman: I've been looking for a blue dress for the party, but all the shops are sold out of my size. Man: Have you checked the online store? They usually have more stock than the physical shop.

passages.title: Recording 5
passages.text: Boy: We need to decide what to do for Sarah's surprise party. Should we order pizza or cook something ourselves? Girl: Let's order pizza. It's much easier and we won't have to clean up the kitchen afterwards.

passages.title: Recording 6
passages.text: Man: I'm really looking forward to the cinema trip on Friday. What time does the film start? Woman: It starts at 7:30, so let's meet outside the entrance at 7:15 to get some popcorn.

passages.title: Recording 7
passages.text: Woman: I've decided to start a photography course next month. Man: That's a brilliant idea! You've always been good at taking pictures. Will it be on weekends or during the week?
